question:
**Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.**

A specialist of kidney
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Nephrologist.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct word that can substitute the given group of words** "A specialist of kidney" **is: **Nephrologist.**
 
• A **nephrologist **is** a medical specialist who specifically focuses on the diagnosis, treatment, and management of kidney-related conditions and diseases.** (एक चिकित्सा विशेषज्ञ जो विशेष रूप से किडनी से संबंधित स्थितियों और बीमारियों के निदान, उपचार और प्रबंधन पर ध्यान केंद्रित करता है)
 
• Nephrologists often work closely with patients who have chronic kidney disease, kidney failure, or other kidney-related disorders, providing specialized care and treatment options.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Now let's have a look at the meaning of the other options.
 
• **Obstetrician- **A medical specialist who specializes in pregnancy, childbirth, and the care of women before, during, and after childbirth.(एक चिकित्सा विशेषज्ञ जो गर्भावस्था, प्रसव और प्रसव से पहले, उसके दौरान और बाद में महिलाओं की देखभाल में विशेषज्ञ होता है) 
 
• **Pathologist- **A medical specialist who examines and diagnoses diseases by studying tissues, cells, and bodily fluids.(एक चिकित्सा विशेषज्ञ जो ऊतकों, कोशिकाओं और शारीरिक तरल पदार्थों का अध्ययन करके रोगों की जांच और निदान करता है) 
 
• **Primatologist-** A scientist who studies primates, such as monkeys and apes, and their behavior, genetics, and ecology.(एक वैज्ञानिक जो बंदरों और वानरों जैसे प्राइमेट्स और उनके व्यवहार, आनुवंशिकी और पारिस्थितिकी का अध्ययन करता है)
